title: Executive Director at Business Consultancy Expects Intuit to Gain Share Modestly as QuickBooks Automation Remains Incremental
expert: Executive Director, North American small-business consultancy (5 ongoing + 5-8 occasional clients; current)
verdict: 99% of this small consultancy's SMB clients run QuickBooks and it expects 5%-10% annual price increases to be absorbed on switching costs; its roughly 50% rise in Intuit work reflects a firm pivot to bookkeeping, not market demand.

Paid-customer and platform growth vs 13-: 🟡 **Intuit-related activity up roughly 50%**, driven by the firm's pivot to bookkeeping with no 2025 comparable; not a read on QBO demand. First read; no earlier expert call. [23 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269324&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse14118&hl=fse14118,fse14686&page=2)
Pricing and ARPC (Tenet 2): 🟢 **5%-10% annual price increases (estimate)** expected to stick on switching costs; below the 2026-08-01 list increases of +13%/+22%/+24% (thesis page). → Tenet 2 (core funnel and pricing) ↑ [25 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269324&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse27067&hl=fse27067,fse27112,fse27205,fse28257&page=2)

🔴 **Clients resisting add-ons and QBO Advanced** when the value of increases is unclear. → Tenet 1 (mid-market) ↓ [13 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269324&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse27112&hl=fse27112,fse28668,fse28987&page=2)
Competition and retention (Tenet 5): 🟢 **99% of SMB clients on QuickBooks**, under 1% elsewhere; consistent with Cleveland's AI-native vendors under 1% share (SB #63132). → Tenet 5 (disruption contained) ↑ [24 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269324&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse16046&hl=fse16046,fse16209,fse17129&page=2)

🔴 **20%, 30% of QuickBooks "makes work harder" (estimate)**; AI only incremental. → Tenet 5 (disruption contained) ↓ [26 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269324&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse42578&hl=fse42578,fse42763,fse42947,fse43405,fse43805&page=2)

changes: Price increases of 5%-10% (estimate) vs 2026-08-01 QBO list increases of +13% Essentials / +22% Plus / +24% Advanced (thesis page data point): expert expects smaller effective increases.
99% QuickBooks share of clients vs AI-native vendors under 1% share (SB #63132): consistent.
First read on consultancy Intuit activity; no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (core funnel and pricing): ↑ — 5%-10% increases expected to be absorbed, though below list-price moves.
Tenet 5 (disruption contained): → — 99% QuickBooks penetration, but 20%, 30% of workflows seen as friction.
Tenet 1 (mid-market): ↓ — resistance to QBO Advanced and add-ons when value is unclear (no number).
